personPicker.label: Who owes you?
personPicker.helper: Pick someone or type a new name.
personPicker.newPerson: {{name}} will be added as a new person.
personPicker.noOptions: No one yet. Type a name to add them.

amount.label: Amount
amount.helper: How much this person owes you for this item.
amount.totalHelper: Split evenly across the cuotas; any extra cents go on the last one.

installments.tooSmall: The total is too small to split into {{count}} cuotas.
installments.needAmount: Enter the total amount to preview the cuotas.

lock.planAllocations: This plan already has payments, so its total, number of cuotas and first due date can't change. You can still edit individual cuotas.
lock.planPardons: This plan has forgiven cuotas, so its total, number of cuotas and first due date can't change. You can still edit individual cuotas.
lock.flatAllocations: This item already has payments, so it can't be split into cuotas.
lock.flatPardons: This item is forgiven, so it can't be split into cuotas.

link.cuotaHint: This expense is cuota {{index}}/{{count}} of {{amount}} ({{total}} in total). Enter the total this person owes you.
link.cuotaPlanHint: This expense is a purchase in {{count}} cuotas of {{amount}} ({{total}} in total). Enter the total this person owes you.
link.overLinked: Debts linked to this expense would add up to {{total}}, more than its {{expense}}. You can still save.
link.overLinkedPlan: Debts linked to this purchase would add up to {{total}}, more than its {{expense}} total ({{count}} cuotas). You can still save.

errors.generic: We couldn't save this item. Check your connection and try again.
errors.lockedAllocations: This plan already has payments, so its total, number of cuotas or first due date can't change. Remove those payments first, or edit individual cuotas instead.
errors.lockedPardons: This plan has forgiven cuotas, so its total, number of cuotas or first due date can't change. Restore those cuotas first, or edit individual cuotas instead.
errors.linkMissing: We couldn't find the linked expense. It may have been deleted. Pick another one or remove the link.
errors.invalidPlan: These cuotas can't be saved. Check the total and the number of cuotas.
errors.idConflict: This item may already have been saved, with different details, on an earlier attempt. Close this form and check the list before adding it again.
errors.belowPaid: Cuota {{index}} can't be less than the {{amount}} already paid.

link.label: Link transaction (optional)
link.helper: The expense this debt came from. Just a reference: balances and budgets don't change.

deletePerson.title: Delete person
deletePerson.body: Delete "{{name}}"? Their items and payments will be removed too. This can't be undone.
deletePerson.error: We couldn't delete this person. Check your connection and try again.

deleteItem.title: Delete item
deleteItem.body: Delete the item from {{date}}? This can't be undone.
deleteItem.error: We couldn't delete this item. Check your connection and try again.

pardonItem.title: Forgive this debt
pardonItem.body: Forgive this debt? It stops counting as owed but will show as "covered by you" on the PDF. You can restore it later.
pardonItem.planBody: Forgive every cuota still owed on this plan? They stop counting as owed but will show as "covered by you" on the PDF. Paid cuotas stay paid, and you can restore them later.
pardonItem.error: We couldn't forgive this item. Check your connection and try again.

pardonCuota.title: Forgive this cuota
pardonCuota.body: Forgive cuota {{index}}/{{count}} of "{{item}}"? It stops counting as owed but will show as "covered by you" on the PDF. You can restore it later.
pardonCuota.error: We couldn't forgive this cuota. Check your connection and try again.

allocation.itemAria: Amount applied to the item from {{date}}
allocation.cuotaAria: Amount applied to cuota {{index}}/{{count}} of the item from {{date}}
allocation.applyToUpcoming: Apply the rest to upcoming cuotas
allocation.overReceived: The lines add up to {{amount}} more than the {{received}} received.
allocation.overTarget: That's {{extra}} more than the {{amount}} it owes. The extra becomes a credit, and you'll be asked to confirm it.
allocation.unassigned: {{amount}} of the {{received}} received isn't assigned to a debt yet. Assign it or change the amount received to record the payment.
allocation.unassignedIncome: {{amount}} of this {{received}} income isn't assigned to a debt yet.
allocation.overIncome: The lines add up to {{amount}} more than this {{received}} income. Lower them to confirm.
allocation.needReceived: Enter the amount received, or use the lines' total.
allocation.putRestOnMenu: Debt to put the rest on
allocation.acknowledgeShortfall: Claim this {{received}} income for only {{amount}}. The rest can't be matched to anyone again.

overpayment.title: More than owed
overpayment.body: This payment of {{requested}} is more than the {{outstanding}} still owed. Record it anyway as a credit?
overpayment.earlyBody: This payment of {{requested}} is more than the {{outstanding}} due right now because it pays cuotas that aren't due yet. Record it as an early payment?
overpayment.targetBody: {{target}} only owes {{remaining}}, but this payment applies {{requested}} to it. Record the extra {{extra}} as a credit?
overpayment.creditBody: Nothing is owed right now (there's already a {{credit}} credit). Record this {{requested}} payment anyway as more credit?

payment.title: Record payment
payment.subtitle: Apply a payment across {{name}}'s open items and cuotas.

payment.noOpenItems: Nothing is outstanding — every item is already settled.
